_note: The tech tree. cost in research points (RP). requires: techs that must be done first. unlocks: buildings, crops, recipes, sizes, levels. bonus: colony-wide multipliers added to 1.0 (e.g. solar_mult 0.2 = +20%). items: special research needs these units delivered to a research lab. family: tier-5 tech that unlocks Level 5 for that building family. branch/tier place the node in the tree screen.
